rationale.A: Through Töölö on Mannerheimintie/Tukholmankatu (260 m in traffic, tram rails), long Paciuksenkatu-side track, 4 unsignalised arterial crossings, 11 lights
rationale.B: Central Park paths via Auroransilta instead of Töölö; no mixed traffic, but the Helsinginkatu-side start and 3 unsignalised crossings; 4 lights
rationale.C: Hammarskjöldintie and Central Park paths, no mixed traffic; only a short Helsinginkatu-side stretch; 4 lights
rationale.D: Like A, through Töölö with Mannerheimintie/Tukholmankatu traffic and Meilahdentie; 10 lights
rationale.E: Mostly paths via Mississippi/Taivallahti, but 80 m on Eino Leinon katu with tram rails, several unsignalised crossings, 9 lights
rationale.F: Quiet Kallio streets, Hammarskjöldintie and Central Park; fewest unsignalised crossings, 3 lights; +2 min
rationale.G: Close to C via Hannes Kolehmaisen lenkki; 5 lights
rationale.H: Central Park and Tilkka paths, car-free but +9 min and extra walking

notes: Every candidate shares the long track beside Kuusisaarentie/Pikkuniementie to Otaniemi, so all differences come from the first ~4 km. B (+1 min, 4 lights) would also do for fewest lights; F (+2 min, 3 lights) gets the card because it is also calmest. B vs C is borderline on same-route (about 1 km on different parallel paths).
